title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 4

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the energy session take place?
tasks.audioText: The energy systems lecturer will discuss electrical energy use on Wednesday at twelve. The session will take place in the main lecture room. Students should read the short note about kilowatt-hours before attending. The lecturer will explain how power and operating time are related and will compare two example energy records.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should students read before attending?
tasks.audioText: The energy systems lecturer will discuss electrical energy use on Wednesday at twelve. The session will take place in the main lecture room. Students should read the short note about kilowatt-hours before attending. The lecturer will explain how power and operating time are related and will compare two example energy records.

tasks.prompt: Electrical energy consumption depends on the power of a device and the time it operates. A device with a higher power rating may use more energy in the same period, although actual consumption also depends on its operating conditions. Energy records often use kilowatt-hours. A student compared two devices and made sure that the measurement periods were equal before drawing a conclusion. Reading 1. What two factors affect energy consumption?
options: The device's power and operating time

tasks.prompt: Why did the student use equal measurement periods?
The energy used by a device depends ___ its power and operating time.
Choose TWO details needed to compare energy consumption fairly.
options: The number of labels on the casing

tasks.prompt: A unit commonly used to record electrical energy consumption is the kilowatt-___.
A classmate compares devices over different time periods. What should you say?
options: We should use equal time periods before comparing the energy records.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of electrical energy in a logical order.
options: Compare energy use over equal periods
Explain the result and its limits
correctOrder: Compare energy use over equal periods
Explain the result and its limits

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how power and operating time affect electrical energy consumption. Include why fair comparisons need equal time periods.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the relationship between power, operating time and energy consumption is explained (0–2); the response explains why comparisons need equal or clearly stated time periods (0–2); the reasoning is logically connected with understandable grammar (0–2); power/energy vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
